about: civic.promptugal.news's page views and reads, sent by assets/obs/obs.js into civic's own observability vault, made by civic.b@PrompTugal.dinis on 18 November 2026 at Dinis Cruz's word (tools/obs-setup-civic.py). Public on purpose (Dinis: 'Those tokens are public by design'): each append token can only append to its lane, and the key can only encrypt. The drain is conductor.b@PrompTugal.dinis's (credentials sealed to its key). Since 19 Nov 2026 there is no IP-based location: the country only, from the browser's own time zone, with no lookup.
what: This site counts page views and reading time, with the country taken from the browser's time zone (no IP lookup), no IP address kept, no cookie and no user-agent string. Do Not Track, Global Privacy Control and the Pause switch in the footer stop it. What is counted: https://promptugal.news/newsroom/observability/index.html
